question: Which of the following is a planet outside our solar system that usually orbits another star in our galaxy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Exoplanet**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exoplanet **is a planet outside our solar system that usually orbits another star in our galaxy.
 
• Planets that orbit around other stars are called exoplanets.
 
• All of the planets in our solar system orbit around the Sun.
 
• Planets that orbit around other stars are called **exoplanets**.
 
• Exoplanets are very hard to see directly with** telescopes.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Mesoplanets **are planetary-mass objects with sizes smaller than **Mercury **but larger than **Ceres**. 
 
• **Super-Earths** are a unique class of exoplanet in the solar system that are more massive than our planet but lighter than the ice giants, according to NASA. 
 
• **Haumea **is roughly the same size as Pluto.
 
 
• It is one of the fastest rotating large objects in our solar system.
